title: Shape of a two-payload code
statement: Suppose a bit string $y$ has the nested pairing form $\langle x,\langle\operatorname{bits}(c),\langle\operatorname{bits}(c'),\operatorname{bits}(s)\rangle\rangle\rangle$. If a machine configuration on input $x$ has code $c$ at scale $s$, then $y$ has the asserted two-payload shape: it has that nested pairing form, and the length of the binary representation of $s$ is at most the length of the binary representation of $y$'s length.
hypotheses_covered: y is the stated nested pairing of x and the binary representations of c, c′, and s
A machine configuration C on input x
The configuration code of C at scale s equals c
